_note: Disguises picked before a job, each learned from its legend ("legend" is a story or tale id). A job offers three of the known ones, and the mission's seed decides their fates: one slips the band past a fight, one lets them strike first, one gets them spotted. {place} is the job's location.

potter.name: Potter
potter.wear: Like the time he swapped clothes with the potter, Robin drives a cart of pots and cries them at half price.
potter.slip: The guards are so busy haggling over cheap pots that the band rolls straight past them into {place}.
potter.surprise: While the guards squabble over a cracked jug, the band tips the cart over and charges!
potter.blown: A guard picks up a pot. 'This is a bucket with a hole in it!' He looks closer. 'And you're Robin Hood!'

beggar.name: Beggar
beggar.wear: Remembering the sturdy old beggar at the crossroads, Robin puts on a patched cloak and a heavy meal-bag.
beggar.slip: Nobody looks twice at a crowd of beggars. The band shuffles right past the guards at {place}.
beggar.surprise: A guard tosses Robin a coin. Robin catches it, throws off his rags, and the beggars leap into action!
beggar.blown: A soldier kicks the meal-bag over, and out roll Robin's arrows. 'That's no beggar!'

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.wear: Just as he did at Nottingham market, Robin puts on a butcher's apron and sells his meat so cheap the whole street crowds round.
butcher.slip: The guards are too busy buying sausages to notice the band slipping into {place}.
butcher.surprise: Robin hands out free sausages, and while the guards munch, the band jumps them!
butcher.blown: The real butcher storms up, red in the face. 'That's MY cart! Guards, seize that thief!'

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.wear: Robin borrows the tinker's bag and hammer, the very ones the tinker once brought to arrest him, and calls for pots to mend.
tinker.slip: The guards wave the noisy tinker through just to be rid of the racket, and the band follows him into {place}.
tinker.surprise: Robin offers to mend a guard's helmet, then claps it down over his eyes. Now!
tinker.blown: Robin tries to mend a sergeant's kettle and knocks a hole right through it. 'You're no tinker!'

friar.name: Poor friar
friar.wear: As on the day of the golden prize, Robin pulls on a friar's robe and hobbles along begging pennies.
friar.slip: The guards bow their heads for the holy brother, and the band walks solemnly past them at {place}.
friar.surprise: The 'friar' asks the guards to kneel for a blessing, and the blessing turns into a scuffle!
friar.blown: A guard notices the friar's muddy green boots. 'Since when do friars carry longbows?'

old_woman.name: Old woman
old_woman.wear: Robin puts on a grey dress and bonnet, just like the day he hid from the Bishop in the old woman's cottage.
old_woman.slip: Who would stop a little old woman? Robin totters past the guards, and the band slips into {place} behind.
old_woman.surprise: The old woman whacks a guard with her basket, and the band charges in after her!
old_woman.blown: A gust of wind lifts the bonnet. 'That old woman has a beard!'

palmer.name: Palmer
palmer.wear: Like Little John among the four beggars, the band wraps up in palmers' robes, with staffs and scallop shells.
palmer.slip: The guards wish the holy travellers a safe road, and the band strolls right through {place}.
palmer.surprise: The palmers stop to ask the way, and while the guards point down the road, the band pounces!
palmer.blown: A guard asks which shrine they're bound for. Three outlaws answer at once, with three different shrines.

fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.wear: Robin becomes 'Simon' the fisherman again, with a basket of herring and a very fishy smell.
fisherman.slip: The smell alone clears the road. The guards hold their noses and wave the band through {place}.
fisherman.surprise: Robin slaps a guard with a herring, and the band piles in while he's still blinking!
fisherman.blown: Robin tangles his net round the sergeant's boots, just like on the boat. 'Worst fisherman I ever saw. Wait a minute...'

greenleaf.name: Sheriff's servant
greenleaf.wear: Little John puts on the Sheriff's livery from his days as 'Reynold Greenleaf', and marches the band along as his prisoners.
greenleaf.slip: 'Prisoners for the Sheriff!' booms John, and the guards let the whole band through {place}.
greenleaf.surprise: John marches his 'prisoners' right up to the guards. Then the prisoners drop their ropes!
greenleaf.blown: The Sheriff's steward squints at John. 'Reynold Greenleaf! You stole the Sheriff's silver plate!'
